title: Unwrapping Retail Peak Season Cyber Threats
description: This report from Unit 42 outlines key cyber threats targeting retail organizations during peak shopping seasons, emphasizing ransomware, data theft, DDoS attacks, digital skimming, and account takeover. It highlights historical incidents and evolving attack trends, including autonomous attacks and AI-driven threats. The report stresses the operational and reputational risks posed by these attacks to retailers and their customers, especially during high-sales periods. It provides mitigation strategies such as zero trust access, advanced endpoint protection, data loss prevention, application-layer defenses, and vulnerability management.
